questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: Consider two Carnot engines of efficiencies $\eta_1$ and $\eta_2$. The first engine absorbs heat $Q_1$ from a heat reservoir $A$ and releases heat $Q_2$ to a heat reservoir $B$. The second engine takes heat $Q_2$ from $B$ and releases heat $Q_3$ to a heat reservoir $C$. If $Q_1 \gt  Q_2 \gt  Q_3$, what is the net efficiency of this combination of the two Carnot engines?
questions.solution:
The efficiency of the first Carnot engine is given by $\eta_1 = 1 - \dfrac{Q_2}{Q_1}$.

This can be rewritten as $\dfrac{Q_2}{Q_1} = 1 - \eta_1$.

The efficiency of the second Carnot engine is given by $\eta_2 = 1 - \dfrac{Q_3}{Q_2}$.

This can be rewritten as $\dfrac{Q_3}{Q_2} = 1 - \eta_2$.

The net efficiency of the combination of the two engines is the total work done divided by the total heat absorbed from the source.

Total work done is $W = W_1 + W_2 = (Q_1 - Q_2) + (Q_2 - Q_3) = Q_1 - Q_3$.

The net efficiency is $\eta = \dfrac{W}{Q_1} = \dfrac{Q_1 - Q_3}{Q_1} = 1 - \dfrac{Q_3}{Q_1}$.

Multiplying the ratios of heat gives $\dfrac{Q_3}{Q_1} = \dfrac{Q_3}{Q_2} \times \dfrac{Q_2}{Q_1} = (1 - \eta_2)(1 - \eta_1)$.

Substituting this into the expression for net efficiency:

$\eta = 1 - (1 - \eta_1)(1 - \eta_2)$

$\eta = 1 - (1 - \eta_1 - \eta_2 + \eta_1\eta_2)$

$\eta = \eta_1 + \eta_2 - \eta_1\eta_2$

Answer: $\eta_1 + \eta_2 - \eta_1\eta_2$

questions.q: Which of the following statements about the P-V diagram of an ideal gas of fixed number of particles is incorrect?
options: Two distinct adiabats never cross each other.
Two distinct isotherms never cross each other.
An isotherm and an adiabat intersect at one point.
An isotherm and an adiabat intersect at more than one point.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: Consider a Carnot heat engine operating between a heat reservoir at temperature 600 K , and an external atmosphere at temperature 300 K . In one cycle, 1000 kJ of heat is extracted from the heat reservoir, and the associated work is input to a reversible refrigerator that operates between 200 K and the same external atmosphere at 300 K . The refrigerator completes one cycle and releases heat into the atmosphere. How much heat is released into the atmosphere at the end of one cycle of the combined system?
